parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Affiliate Tracker
Runs every Monday.
Fetches weekly stats + affiliate list from Google Sheets.
Calculates per-affiliate: clicks, conversions, CVR, revenue, commission owed.
GPT-4o identifies top performers, underperformers, inactive affiliates.
Sends personal congrats email to top performer.
Weekly Slack report for program health.

Sheets format: Weekly Stats (ID, Clicks, Conversions, Revenue) + Affiliates (ID, Name, Email, Commission %)
